title: Maine Surf Dashboard
---

```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(data.table)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ModWaves <- readRDS("/home/prm6/Documents/MaineSurfDashboard/Data/ModWavesExample.rds")

api_key <- Sys.getenv("STORMGLASS_KEY")

if (api_key == "") {
  stop("STORMGLASS_KEY not found")
}

url <- "https://api.stormglass.io/v2/weather/point"
# url <- "https://api.stormglass.io/v2/historical/point"

res <- GET(
  url,
  add_headers(
    Authorization = api_key
  ),
  query = list(
    lat = 43.163338,
    lng = -70.615757,
    params = "swellDirection,swellHeight,swellPeriod,secondarySwellDirection,secondarySwellHeight,secondarySwellPeriod,waterTemperature,waveDirection,waveHeight,wavePeriod,windWaveDirection,windWaveHeight,windWavePeriod,currentDirection,currentSpeed,windSpeed,windDirection",
    source = "sg"
  )
)

Waves <- as.data.table(fromJSON(content(res, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))$hours)

Waves[,DateTime := with_tz(ymd_hms(time), "America/New_York")]

Waves[,time := NULL]

ModWaves <- Waves

# ModWaves <- as.data.table(pivot_wider(pivot_longer(Waves, 1:(length(Waves)-1), names_pattern = "(^[[:alpha:]]+)\\.(.+$)",
#                                                    names_to = c("Metric", "Model")), names_from = "Metric", values_from = "value"))

ModWaves[,swellHeight_ft := swellHeight*3.28084]
ModWaves[,waveHeight_ft := waveHeight*3.28084]
ModWaves[,windWaveHeight_ft := windWaveHeight*3.28084]
ModWaves[,secondarySwellHeight_ft := secondarySwellHeight*3.28084]

ModWaves[,waterTemperature_f := waterTemperature*(9/5)+32]

ModWaves[,PrimaryEnergyScore := (swellHeight^2)*swellPeriod]

ModWaves[,Date := date(DateTime)]

Energy <- ggplot(ModWaves, aes(DateTime, PrimaryEnergyScore))+
  # geom_smooth(span = 0.05, method = "loess", se = F, linewidth = 1.5)+
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5, color = "#006D75")+
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "24 hours", date_labels = "%b %d (%a) %I%p", date_minor_breaks = "4 hours")+
  labs(x = "Time", y = "Energy Score")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1), text = element_text(color = "white"), panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey30"), panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(color = "grey20"),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#101010"), plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#101010"),
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#101010"), axis.line = element_line(color = "grey30"), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "grey85"))

WaveHeight <- ggplot(ModWaves, aes(DateTime, waveHeight_ft))+
  # geom_smooth(span = 0.05, method = "loess", se = F, linewidth = 1.5)+
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5, color = "#006D75")+
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "24 hours", date_labels = "%b %d (%a) %I%p", date_minor_breaks = "4 hours")+
  labs(x = "Time", y = "Wave Height (ft)")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1), text = element_text(color = "white"), panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey30"), panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(color = "grey20"),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#101010"), plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#101010"),
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#101010"), axis.line = element_line(color = "grey30"), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "grey85"))

SwellHeight <- ggplot(ModWaves, aes(DateTime, swellHeight_ft))+
 # geom_smooth(span = 0.05, method = "loess", se = F, linewidth = 1.5)+
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5, color = "#006D75")+
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "24 hours", date_labels = "%b %d (%a) %I%p", date_minor_breaks = "4 hours")+
  labs(x = "Time", y = "Swell Height (ft)")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1), text = element_text(color = "white"), panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey30"), panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(color = "grey20"),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#101010"), plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#101010"),
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#101010"), axis.line = element_line(color = "grey30"), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "grey85"))

SwellPeriod <- ggplot(ModWaves, aes(DateTime, swellPeriod))+
  # geom_smooth(span = 0.05, method = "loess", se = F, linewidth = 1.5)+
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5, color = "#006D75")+
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "24 hours", date_labels = "%b %d (%a) %I%p", date_minor_breaks = "4 hours")+
  labs(x = "Time", y = "Swell Period (s)")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1), text = element_text(color = "white"), panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey30"), panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(color = "grey20"),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#101010"), plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#101010"),
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#101010"), axis.line = element_line(color = "grey30"), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "grey85"))

WaterTemp <- ggplot(ModWaves, aes(DateTime, waterTemperature_f))+
  # geom_smooth(span = 0.05, method = "loess", se = F, linewidth = 1.5)+
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5, color = "#006D75")+
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "24 hours", date_labels = "%b %d (%a) %I%p", date_minor_breaks = "4 hours")+
  labs(x = "Time", y = "Water Temp. (F)")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1), text = element_text(color = "white"), panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey30"), panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(color = "grey20"),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#101010"), plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#101010"),
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#101010"), axis.line = element_line(color = "grey30"), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "grey85"))

SwellDir <- ggplot(ModWaves, aes(swellDirection, DateTime))+
  coord_radial(start = 0, end = 2*pi, clip = "off", expand = F, thetalim = c(0, 360))+
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, aes(color = swellHeight_ft))+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 360, 90))+
  scale_y_datetime(date_breaks = "6 hours", date_minor_breaks = "3 hours", date_labels = "%I %p")+
  facet_wrap(vars(Date), scales = "free_y")+
    theme_classic()+
  labs(x = "Swell Direction", y = "Time", color = "Swell Height (ft)")+
  theme(text = element_text(color = "white"), panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey30"), panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey20"),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#101010"), plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#101010"),
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#101010"), axis.line = element_line(color = "grey30"), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "grey85"),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey30"), strip.text = element_text(color = "white", face = "bold"))

WindDir <- ggplot(ModWaves, aes(windDirection*2.237, DateTime))+
  coord_radial(start = 0, end = 2*pi, clip = "off", expand = F, thetalim = c(0, 360))+
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, aes(color = windSpeed))+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 360, 90))+
  scale_y_datetime(date_breaks = "6 hours", date_minor_breaks = "3 hours", date_labels = "%I %p")+
  facet_wrap(vars(Date), scales = "free_y")+
    theme_classic()+
  labs(x = "Wind Direction", y = "Time", color = "Wind Speed (MPH)")+
  theme(text = element_text(color = "white"), panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey30"), panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey20"),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#101010"), plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#101010"),
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#101010"), axis.line = element_line(color = "grey30"), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "grey85"),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey30"), strip.text = element_text(color = "white", face = "bold"))

```
